anchoring.finding: Anchoring: a reference price (MRP or compare-at price) shapes perceived value, so showing the saving next to the selling price makes the offer register instantly.

baymard-abandon.source: Baymard Institute, Cart Abandonment Rate statistics
baymard-abandon.finding: The documented average cart abandonment rate is about 70%. Extra costs (shipping, taxes, fees) revealed late are the #1 reason shoppers abandon; slow delivery, not trusting the site with card details and an unsatisfactory returns policy are also among the top reasons.

baymard-pdp.source: Baymard Institute, Product Page UX research
baymard-pdp.finding: Shoppers judge products mainly through images and product information; when key details (scale, variations, specs, delivery) are missing or hard to find, they leave the page or look elsewhere. Variation options should be visible (buttons or swatches) rather than hidden in drop-downs.

ccpa-dark.source: Central Consumer Protection Authority (India), Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023
ccpa-dark.finding: Lists 13 dark patterns, including false urgency, basket sneaking, confirm shaming and drip pricing; urgency, scarcity and price claims must be true and fully disclosed.

choice-overload.source: Iyengar & Lepper, When Choice is Demotivating (2000)
choice-overload.finding: Shoppers shown 6 jam flavours were about ten times more likely to buy (30%) than those shown 24 (3%): too many competing options and CTAs stall decisions.

cialdini-proof.finding: Social proof: under uncertainty people follow what others like them have done, which is why visible ratings, review counts and real customer photos reduce hesitation.

deloitte-speed.source: Deloitte for Google, Milliseconds Make Millions (2020)
deloitte-speed.finding: A 0.1s improvement in mobile site speed increased retail conversions by 8.4% and average order value by 9.2%.

fitts.finding: The time to hit a target grows with its distance and shrinks with its size, so a large CTA that stays within reach (sticky) is faster and easier to tap.

google-cwv.finding: Good thresholds at the 75th percentile of visits: LCP 2.5s or less, INP 200ms or less, CLS 0.1 or less.

google-interstitials.source: Google Search Central, intrusive interstitials guidance
google-interstitials.finding: Popups that cover the main content on mobile make it hard to access and can hurt how the page performs in Google Search.

google-product-schema.source: Google Search Central, Product structured data
google-product-schema.finding: Product markup with offers and aggregateRating makes pages eligible for price, availability and review star rich results.

google-speed.source: Google / SOASTA research, Think with Google (2017)
google-speed.finding: As mobile page load time goes from 1s to 3s, the probability of a bounce increases 32%; from 1s to 5s, it increases 90%.

india-lm.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended in 2017 (India)
india-lm.finding: E-commerce listings of packaged goods must show declarations such as manufacturer or packer, net quantity, MRP inclusive of all taxes, country of origin and consumer-care details.

lighthouse-font.source: Google Lighthouse, legible font sizes audit; Apple HIG
lighthouse-font.finding: Lighthouse flags text below 12px as illegible on mobile; platform guidelines set body text larger (Apple's default body style is 17pt).

nng-fold.source: Nielsen Norman Group, Scrolling and Attention (2018)
nng-fold.finding: 57% of page-viewing time is spent above the fold and 74% within the first two screenfuls, so what the first screen shows gets most of the attention.

nng-scan.source: Nielsen Norman Group, Concise, Scannable and Objective writing study
nng-scan.finding: Users scan web pages rather than read them; a concise, scannable, objective version of a page measured 124% better usability than the original.

spiegel-reviews.source: Spiegel Research Center, Northwestern University, How Online Reviews Influence Sales (2017)
spiegel-reviews.finding: A product with five reviews is 270% more likely to be purchased than one with none. Purchase likelihood peaks for average ratings of 4.0-4.7 and falls as ratings approach 5.0, and reviews matter more for higher-priced products.

wcag-contrast.finding: Text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (3:1 for large text).

wcag-target.source: W3C WCAG 2.2, SC 2.5.5 and 2.5.8 Target Size
wcag-target.finding: Touch targets of 44x44 CSS px meet the enhanced level (24x24 is the minimum); Apple's Human Interface Guidelines also recommend 44pt.

wyzowl-video.source: Wyzowl, State of Video Marketing (annual survey)
wyzowl-video.finding: In every recent edition, over 80% of consumers say a brand's video has convinced them to buy a product.
